using System;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Chroma;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Http;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Chroma.UnitTests;

public class ChromaClientTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task ExecuteHttpRequestAsync_LogsError_OnHttpOperationException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<ChromaClient>>();
        var mockHttpClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();

        var httpOperationException = new HttpOperationException
        {
            Request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Get, "/test/path"),
            ResponseContent = "Server error response",
            Message = "HTTP operation failed"
        };

        mockHttpClient
            .Setup(c => c.SendWithSuccessCheckAsync(It.IsAny<HttpRequestMessage>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .ThrowsAsync(httpOperationException);

        var client = new ChromaClient(mockHttpClient.Object, endpoint: "http://test-endpoint", loggerFactory: new LoggerFactory().AddProvider(new MockLoggerProvider(mockLogger.Object)));

        // Act & Assert
        var exception = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<HttpOperationException>(() => client.CreateCollectionAsync("test", CancellationToken.None));

        mockLogger.Verify(
            l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>(
                    log => log.ToString().Contains("GET") && log.ToString().Contains("/test/path") && log.ToString().Contains("HTTP operation failed") && log.ToString().Contains("Server error response")),
                httpOperationException,
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    private class MockLoggerProvider : ILoggerProvider
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger> _logger;

        public MockLoggerProvider(Mock<ILogger> logger)
        {
            _logger = logger;
        }

        public ILogger CreateLogger(string categoryName) => _logger.Object;

        public void Dispose() { }
    }
}

using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Chroma;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Http;
using Moq;
using Moq.Language.Flow;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Chroma.UnitTests;

public class ChromaClientTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task ExecuteHttpRequestAsync_LogsError_OnHttpOperationException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<ChromaClient>>();
        var mockHttpClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();

        var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Get, "/api/v1/test");
        var httpOperationException = new HttpOperationException("Test failure")
        {
            ResponseContent = "Test response content"
        };

        mockHttpClient
            .Setup(c => c.SendAsync(It.IsAny<HttpRequestMessage>(), It.IsAny<HttpCompletionOption>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .ThrowsAsync(new HttpRequestException()); // Triggers SendWithSuccessCheckAsync to throw HttpOperationException

        var chromaClient = new ChromaClient(mockHttpClient.Object, endpoint: "http://test-endpoint")
        {
            _logger = mockLogger.Object
        };

        // Act & Assert
        var exception = await Assert.ThrowsAnyAsync<HttpOperationException>(
            () => chromaClient.CreateCollectionAsync("test", CancellationToken.None));

        mockLogger.Verify(
            l => l.LogError(
                httpOperationException,
                It.Is<string>(msg => msg == "{Method} {Path} operation failed: {Message}, {Response}"),
                It.Is<object[]>(args => 
                    args.Length == 4 && 
                    args[0].ToString()!.Contains("GET") && 
                    args[1].ToString()!.Contains("test") && 
                    args[2].ToString() == "Test failure" && 
                    args[3].ToString() == "Test response content")),
            Times.Once);
    }
}
